text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru and I are on an uninhabited island for some rest. Just as we're about to leave…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ack, we missed the last train! Well, the last boat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru told me there was still time before the last departure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finding this suspicious, I press her on the topic…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: N-no, well, you see… All right, you got me! Or not… What I mean is…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I lied to you about the time on purpose.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I want to be stranded on this island with you. And it has to be today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: There's actually supposed to be a meteor shower happening here tonight…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I just had to see it with you and make my wish! No ifs, ands, or buts!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Like, something like this might never happen again. That's why I couldn't help trying anything and everything to create this memory with you.
choice_data_list: You could have just told it to me straight…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But if you'd said no, I wouldn't have been able to take it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: If you'd told me you'd rather die than stay and watch, I don't know what I'd have done. I would've probably just fallen to my knees and begged right here on the beach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'd never say something like that to begin with… At any rate, we decide to watch the meteor shower together.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, it's almost time. It's going to be the best ever, ever, ever, ever!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Meteor showers are so powerful, aren't they? Seeing all these heavenly bodies whiz by makes me feel like I could run just as fast…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, here come some more! Look at them zoom! They should be called Matikanefuku-komets instead!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This is so beautiful, I'm getting emotional. Oh, if only I could watch this forever…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hm, I feel like something is slipping my mind. What is it you're supposed to do when you see a shooting star again?
choice_data_list: You're supposed to make a wish.
You're supposed to sprint along the beach.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, that's it! I have tons of wishes backed up! Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: May we attain many glorious victories together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Loads and loads of them! One race for every meteor in the sky! Pretty please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us wish as hard as we can for Matikanefukukitaru to seize countless victories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I did it again, Trainer! I won! I won again!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehe. This is thanks to all that wishing we did while watching the meteor shower.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I want to visit that uninhabited island again! If we become castaways and end up washed ashore, then so be it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's talking like we're in some kind of survival flick. That aside, it looks like wishing on that meteor shower did have some out-of-this-world benefits.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Was that it? …Well, I guess having a meteor to race against is a unique opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: All right! Wait for me, meteors! We'll see who can make it around the world first!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru runs off without a care in the world. Right across the beach, along the shore… and then into the water.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gulp! Gurgle! Trainer… hrulp mreee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She comes concerningly close to actually drowning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it! I won yet again! What did you make of that speed?! I flew in like a meteor!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Looks like those meteors rubbed off on me when I was chasing after them. What a miracle that is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think almost drowning has improved her lung capacity.
